subject: Renewal expansion: split-payor setup and Net45 exception request
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.inference.com>
To: Elena Morales <procurement@cloudline-sys.com>, Jared Kim <finance@cloudline-sys.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Aug 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal expansion: split-payor setup and Net45 exception request

Hi Elena / Jared —

Thanks again for the productive renewal call earlier this week. Cloudline is set to accept the 20% capacity uplift for Q4 (we've reflected the new committed units in the attached PO stub). Before we finalize, two billing items we need to align on:

1) Payor split: you mentioned that the parent (Cloudline Systems, TIN: 12-3456789) will cover the base commitment and the EU subsidiary (Cloudline EU SARL) will cover the new add-on. We can split invoices — please confirm the two billing contacts, legal names, and remit emails.

2) Net terms: Cloudline asked if we can move to Net45 for the renewal invoice as a one-time procurement exception (their purchasing cycles now align to Net45). Our standard hosted API renewals default to Net30; to approve Net45 we need Finance sign-off plus the signed PO and W-9 on file.

Attached: a copy of the PO you circulated (Cloudline_PO_9573.pdf). If you can confirm the billing contacts and re-attach a completed W-9 for the US entity, we can initiate the Net45 exception review.

Next steps I propose: Elena to send final PO + W-9 -> Redwood finance (Marissa) triages Net45 exception -> I prepare a short amendment for signature (DocuSign).

Thanks — small ask: can you confirm by Monday EOD 8/19 so we can hit the planned 9/1 go-live for the additional capacity?

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Elena Morales <procurement@cloudline-sys.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Jared Kim <finance@cloudline-sys.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Aug 2029 08:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal expansion: split-payor setup and Net45 exception request

Diego —

Thanks for the clear summary. Attached is the signed PO (Cloudline_PO_9573.pdf) and a copy of the Cloudline Group W-9 for the US payor (Cloudline_W9.pdf).

Answers inline:
- Payor split: yes — parent will pay the committed baseline; EU SARL will pay the add-on. Billing contacts:
  * Parent (Cloudline Systems): accounts-payable@cloudline-sys.com, Attn: Jared Kim (Treasury)
  * EU SARL: eu-invoices@cloudline-eu.com, Attn: Sofia Alvarez (FP&A)

- Net45: procurement prefers Net45 and is prepared to route the PO as-is if your finance team approves the Net45 exception.

We can accept a conditional amendment for signature that includes the split-invoicing language and the net-term change. Please send the DocuSign link.

Best regards,
Elena Morales
Head of Procurement | Cloudline Systems
procurement@cloudline-sys.com
Attachment: Cloudline_PO_9573.pdf
Attachment: Cloudline_W9.pdf

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.inference.com>
To: Elena Morales <procurement@cloudline-sys.com>, Jared Kim <finance@cloudline-sys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Aug 2029 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal expansion: split-payor setup and Net45 exception request

Elena — thanks for the quick turnaround and for attaching the PO + W-9.

Marissa / Karthik — can you triage this? Summary: Cloudline submitted signed PO (attached) and W-9; they request Net45 one-time exception and split invoices between two payors. Key asks for Finance:
- Confirm Net45 exception (one-off, tied to this renewal + add-on)
- Confirm we can bill the two remit emails as separate invoices in our billing system (they will be two distinct legal entities on the contract)

If approved, I'll prepare a 1-paragraph amendment (Redwood_Net45_amendment.docx) and send via DocuSign to Elena for execution. If Finance needs any additional credit docs, let me know and I will request them from Cloudline.

Diego

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Elena Morales <procurement@cloudline-sys.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Aug 2029 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal expansion: split-payor setup and Net45 exception request

Diego / team —

Reviewed Cloudline PO and W-9. We can approve the Net45 exception on the following conditions:
1) Both legal names must be on the master contract as signed parties (we will add the EU SARL as a bill-to on the amendment).
2) We issue two invoices: baseline to parent (accounts-payable@cloudline-sys.com) and the add-on to EU SARL (eu-invoices@cloudline-eu.com). Our billing system will accept two remit-to addresses provided the legal entity IDs match the PO.
3) Finance requires the signed PO (attached) and the W-9 on file prior to payment terms change.

Diego — please send the short amendment to Elena and include the clause below: "Invoices for separately identified legal entities will be issued to their respective remit-to addresses; payment terms for the baseline commitment are Net30; payment terms for the add-on described in PO 9573 are Net45 for this renewal only." If Cloudline signs, we will execute the amendment and confirm the invoice schedule.

Marissa Cole
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com
Attachment referenced: Redwood_Net45_amendment.docx
